deploy.on_merge: Vercel's Git integration (root directory axiepro) builds main and deploys production at https://www.axiepro.io; axiepro.io answers 307 to www, and app.axiepro.io and frontend-eight-cyan-60.vercel.app serve the same build (checked 2026-11-05). Frontend CI (npm ci, tsc, build) runs on pushes and pull requests that touch axiepro/**. The legacy Cloudflare Pages copy, axiepro.pages.dev, is not updated by a merge and still serves the template favicon (checked 2026-11-05); DEPLOY.md's hand wrangler deploy, with Yu's Cloudflare login, is the only way to update it
deploy.after_deploy: Vercel answers public, max-age=0, must-revalidate and its edge cache is per deployment, so no purge (measured 2026-11-05). Then check per wiring.md §7 on https://www.axiepro.io: the eight served files answer 200 with their types and the kit's bytes; og:image, one theme-color #05050D and one color-scheme dark sit in <head> for the crawler user agents
deploy.rules: No AGENTS.md or contributing rules. /README.md 'Orientation': pure understanding, no revenue, KPI or conversion requirement; paid tiers retired (/PRICING.md). The backend is down and deploys by hand only until leaked keys are rotated (/STATE.md, deploy-backend.yml); nothing here touches it. A merge to main deploys production, so it needs Yu's word, or the repository owner's, for that merge. A new CI step is a new gate, which PR #3 left to the owner

notes: The guard is wired by this draft: a step `npm run test:brand` (node brand/check.mjs, in axiepro/package.json) in /.github/workflows/frontend-ci.yml, before npm ci, on pushes to main and pull requests that touch axiepro/**. The repository has no unit-test runner, so it is a plain node step. Adding it is a new gate, the owner's call.

The spec lives inside the kit, at kit/source/brand.json: the kit was built from a spec folder outside the repository, keeps that brand.json normalised as source/brand.json, and rebuilds from it in place (PR #3). There is no brand.json or mark.svg beside kit/; kit/source/mark-source.svg is the mark and kit/source/mark-small.svg its 16-48 px cut.
The header and footer still show the gradient public/logo-simple.svg, which is not a kit file.
src/app/globals.css has @source not "../../brand", which keeps this whole folder out of Tailwind's class scan.
No test checks the Next.js head tags here; PR #3 checked the built head by hand, and site.layout covers only the layout's viewport.

kit/BRAND.md says Inter Light's licence 'was not checked': the installed files' name tables say SIL OFL 1.1. Inter SemiBold and JetBrains Mono are bundled with vectorcraft-cli, so they have no file to list.
PR #3 accepted six verify warnings, among them the #0F0F14 tile at 1.19:1 on Chrome's dark tab strip.
